privacyBoundary: register contains release identifiers, paths, closure actions and authority references only
final evidence must not contain raw secrets, database URLs, host IPs, customer data, raw logs, private keys, provider payloads or prompt transcripts

blockers.title: Protected staging activation evidence is missing
blockers.closureAction: Run protected GitHub Environment `staging` on the intended self-hosted runner and attach the accepted artifact, detached digest and verifier summary.

blockers.title: Production-like environment configuration is not proven
blockers.closureAction: Run `env:check` in protected staging with either the protected host env file loaded or the service-manager preloaded environment verified, then preserve redacted evidence for required URLs, secrets presence, proxy trust and `DATABASE_URL` without exposing values.

blockers.title: Immutable runtime image digest is recorded
blockers.closureAction: Accepted for immutable runtime image identity only; preserve the container release artifact and signature verification for the exact staging target SHA.
blockers.launchImpact: Exact release identity recorded; Go remains blocked by remaining operational evidence

blockers.title: Exact-head workflow URLs are not attached to a final manifest
blockers.closureAction: Attach exact-head CI, repository audit, Public Browser Golden Path and secret scanning workflow URLs for the staging target SHA.

blockers.title: Backup, restore and recovery reconciliation evidence is missing
blockers.closureAction: Execute protected staging restore and domain reconciliation for Academy, Arena, Mentor, Exchange ledger, notifications/jobs and tenant/principal isolation.

blockers.title: Rollback or forward-fix evidence is missing
blockers.closureAction: Prove rollback from the staging target to the previous accepted release, or record an approved irreversible-migration forward-fix decision with owner.

blockers.title: Incident readiness evidence is missing
blockers.closureAction: Run two synthetic critical alert probes, prove latency under five minutes, zero pending/quarantine, and record P0 acknowledgement drill.

blockers.title: Accepted-risk sign-off is not final evidence
blockers.closureAction: Attach owner-approved accepted-risk sign-off for this exact candidate, including review dates, thresholds, user communication and rollback triggers.

blockers.title: Go approval matrix is missing
blockers.closureAction: Attach approvals from CEO, CTO/Chief Architect, Security, Product, Compliance, SRE and QA for the exact candidate and launch scope.

blockers.title: Real-money Exchange remains uncertified
blockers.closureAction: Keep Exchange launch-disabled until decimal conservation, order/trade/hold/balance/fee/ledger reconciliation, ambiguous-result recovery and provider evidence are accepted.

blockers.title: Custody, deposits and withdrawals remain uncertified
blockers.closureAction: Keep custody/deposit/withdrawal paths product-disabled until HSM/MPC, chain-provider certification, on-chain reconciliation and settlement evidence are accepted.

blockers.title: Enterprise, white-label and public rewards remain outside launch scope
blockers.closureAction: Preserve route/env/UI/copy guards so these surfaces cannot be advertised or activated by accident.

recommendedNextSlice.description: Collect protected staging activation evidence and redacted env:check evidence for the current candidate SHA after PR #388, with either the protected host env file loaded or the service-manager preloaded environment verified for NOG-02.
